newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian prostitutes to hold open day.
newsitem.headline: Belgian prostitutes to hold open day.

text.p: Prostitutes in the Belgian port of Antwerp will hold an open day on Saturday to break down barriers with the public and prove the red light district is safe, the organising committee said on Wednesday.
"Prostitutes will offer coffee and other drinks," a spokesman told BRTN radio.
He said bands and acrobats would perform during the day which would give people a chance to "see the rooms where it all happens".
"We want to show what's really going on here, that it's not a crime-ridden area," he said.

City authorities have threatened to ban prostitution in part of the 'Skippers' quarter' near the river Scheldt. An earlier attempt to close down part of the district failed after a similar open day event in 1993 attracted international media attention.
